text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Monday:
- Nearly 1,500 people protested again in Freiburg last Friday against the shutting down of the Cardinal brewery.
- Canon (Schweiz) AG, formerly Walter Rentsch AG, posted a sales decline of 6.5 percent to 289.3 million Swiss francs for 1996.
- Swiss Minister Jean-Pascal Delamuraz said he finds the Socialist Party's demand for his resignation unacceptable and that he will not quit.
- Carlo Jagmetti, Swiss Ambassador to the United States, may be suspended from his job because of comments he made on Switzerland's role in World War Two, which insulted several organisations.
- Swiss retailers lose a total of 1.5 billion Swiss francs annually due to theft.
- Hero food group said it is reducing its product line from 4,000 to 2,000 items and concentrating on its core businesses of marmelade and fruit, fresh food and pasta.
